--- diagram: cicd-pr-gate-activity uml-type: Activity Diagram (PR Gate) source: docs/CICD.md §5 PR Gate, §10.3 Vulnerability Scanning generated: 2026-05-08 --- # PR Gate Activity Diagram — Pull Request 合併前檢查流程 > 來源：docs/CICD.md §5.1 PR Gate 清單 + §5.2 Branch Protection Rules + §10.3 Vulnerability Scanning。 > Branch Protection 規則：required_status_checks 必須通過；required_pull_request_reviews ≥ 1。 ```mermaid flowchart TD Start(("Developer: git push to PR branch")) --> Checkout Checkout["Stage 1: Checkout
(actions/checkout@v4)"] --> Build Build{"Stage 2: Build<br/>make ci-build (dotnet build)"} -->|"PASS"| UnitTest Build -->|"FAIL"| Reject1(("PR BLOCKED — Build failure (dotnet compile error)")) UnitTest{"Stage 3: Unit Test<br/>make ci-test-unit (xUnit + coverage ≥ 80%)"} -->|"PASS"| IntTest UnitTest -->|"FAIL"| Reject2(("PR BLOCKED — Unit test failure or coverage shortfall")) IntTest{"Stage 4: Integration Test<br/>make ci-test-integration (Testcontainers PG)"} -->|"PASS"| ImgBuild IntTest -->|"FAIL"| Reject3(("PR BLOCKED — Integration test failure")) ImgBuild{"Stage 5: Image Build<br/>Kaniko / docker buildx"} -->|"PASS"| NugetScan ImgBuild -->|"FAIL"| Reject4(("PR BLOCKED — Image build failed")) ImgBuild -->|"SKIP (commit prefix [skip-image])"| NugetScan NugetScan{"NuGet Vulnerability Scan<br/>dotnet list package --vulnerable"} -->|"PASS or NONE"| TrivyScan NugetScan -->|"CRITICAL or HIGH"| Reject5(("PR BLOCKED — NuGet CVE (CRITICAL or HIGH)")) TrivyScan{"Trivy Container Scan<br/>aquasecurity/trivy-action@master"} -->|"PASS"| ReviewGate TrivyScan -->|"CRITICAL or HIGH"| Reject6(("PR BLOCKED — Container CVE (CRITICAL or HIGH)")) ReviewGate{"Code Owner Review<br/>required_approving_review_count ≥ 1"} -->|"Approved"| AllPass ReviewGate -->|"Changes requested"| FixCode(("Developer: 修復程式碼 + push")) FixCode --> Checkout AllPass(("All Gate Checks PASSED")) --> MergeReady MergeReady(("Merge to main (squash + rebase, linear history)")) classDef stage fill:#cfe2ff,stroke:#0d6efd,stroke-width:2px,color:#000 classDef block fill:#f8d7da,stroke:#dc3545,stroke-width:2px,color:#000 classDef pass fill:#d1e7dd,stroke:#198754,stroke-width:2px,color:#000 class Checkout,Build,UnitTest,IntTest,ImgBuild,NugetScan,TrivyScan,ReviewGate stage class Reject1,Reject2,Reject3,Reject4,Reject5,Reject6 block class AllPass,MergeReady pass ``` ## Gate 條件對照（CICD §5.1） | Stage / Job | 必須通過 | 允許跳過條件 | |-------------|---------|------------| | `build` (`make ci-build`) | ✅ 必須 | 無 | | `unit-test` (`make ci-test-unit`) | ✅ 必須 | 無 | | `integration-test` (`make ci-test-integration`) | ✅ 必須 | 無 | | `image-build` | ⚠️ 必須 | `[skip-image]` commit prefix（hot-fix 除外） | | NuGet vulnerable scan | ✅ 必須 | 無 | | Trivy container scan | ✅ 必須 | 無 | | Code Owner Review | ✅ 必須 ≥ 1 | 無 | ## Pre-PR 開發者本地清單（§5.3） 開發者在 push PR 前自行執行： 1. `make ci-build` 2. `make ci-test-unit` 3. `make k8s-apply && make ci-test-integration` 4. `make test-bdd-server` / `make test-bdd-client` 5. `make ci-dry-run`（act 本地模擬） 6. `grep -E '\{\{[A-Z_]+\}\}' .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml`（無裸 placeholder） 7. credential 明文掃描
